name: qkd_static_kv_landing_seg-ls2-COMMIT
purpose: KV/system die STATIC landing segment qkd_static_kv_landing_seg (= qkd_static_kv_landing_physical_grp VMAP=1 VREQ=1 with cfg strap ports and one clock): 4 PCs each with its real 128x256 SRAM, per-PC hop38/hop295 branch stages, VREQ row control; fixed-cycle (latency 8 edges), no flow control. ONE master replicated 32x.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_static_kv_landing_seg u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_landing_seg.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_landing.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_hop.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: landing_seg_exact
bench.note: tb_static_landing PHYS=1 VMAP=1 VREQ=1: 32 segments on their straps, 128 PCs, K at CTX 1000/2048/4096/8192 + the PV16 V walk, every row word / t / kind on its edge (latency 8); fault modes 1-5 and the aliasing K ordinal (DUT_MUT 3 at CTX 2048) must FAIL

bench.name: landing_seg_mutant
bench.note: branch-0 response hop flips a data bit (HOP_MUT 1)

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters
